questions.text: INS Vikrant (IAC-1), commissioned into the Indian Navy in September 2022, is distinct because it is India's first:

options.label: C
options.text: Indigenously designed and built Aircraft Carrier

questions.solution: Shortcut: Keyword 'Indigenous' + 'Aircraft Carrier'. INS Vikramaditya was purchased from Russia (modified Kiev-class). INS Viraat was ex-HMS Hermes (British). INS Vikrant (IAC-1) is the first built in India (Cochin Shipyard). Full Solution: INS Vikrant (Indigenous Aircraft Carrier-1) is the first aircraft carrier to be designed by the Indian Navy's Directorate of Naval Design and built at Cochin Shipyard Limited for the Indian Navy. It displaces approx 45,000 tonnes. Previous carriers INS Vikrant (R11, 1961), INS Viraat (R22, 1987), and INS Vikramaditya (R33, 2013) were all acquired from the UK or Russia. The ship's motto is 'Jayema Sam Yudhi Spridhah' (I conquer those who fight against me) from Rigveda.

questions.text: A body starts from rest and moves with a uniform acceleration of 5 m/s². What will be its velocity after covering a distance of 20 m?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use v² = u² + 2as. Since u=0, v = √(2as) = √(2×5×20) = √200 = 10√2 m/s. Option elimination: √2 ≈ 1.414, so value ≈ 14.14 m/s; only option B matches the exact surd form. Step-by-step: Initial velocity u = 0, Acceleration a = 5 m/s², Displacement s = 20 m. Using third equation of motion: v² = 0² + 2(5)(20) = 200. Therefore, v = √200 = 10√2 m/s.

questions.text: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, "She is the only daughter of the only son of my father's father." How is the woman in the photograph related to the man?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Only son of my father's father' is my Father. 'Only daughter of my Father' is my Sister. Full Method: The man's father's father is his paternal grandfather. The only son of the grandfather is the man's father (assuming no paternal uncles). The only daughter of that father is the man's sister (or the man himself if female, but 'she' confirms female). Thus, the woman is the man's sister.

questions.text: Which crop is most characteristically associated with 'Regur Soil' (Black Cotton Soil) found extensively in the Deccan Plateau?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use the alternative name 'Black Cotton Soil' given in the stem itself. The name 'Cotton' is explicitly embedded in the common nomenclature of the soil. Full Solution: Regur soil, commonly known as Black Cotton Soil, is formed from the weathering of basaltic lava rocks (Deccan Traps). It is rich in lime, iron, magnesia, and alumina but deficient in phosphorus, nitrogen, and organic matter. Its high moisture retention capacity and clayey texture make it ideal for cotton cultivation. It covers most of Maharashtra, parts of Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu.

questions.text: The difference between Compound Interest (compounded annually) and Simple Interest on a sum of ₹1600 for 2 years is ₹16. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For 2 years, Difference (CI - SI) = P × (R/100)². Substituting values: 16 = 1600 × (R/100)² ⇒ (R/100)² = 16/1600 = 1/100 ⇒ R/100 = 1/10 ⇒ R = 10%. Full Solution: SI for 2 years = (1600 × R × 2)/100 = 32R. Amount in CI = 1600(1 + R/100)² = 1600(1 + 2R/100 + R²/10000). CI = Amount - P = 32R + 1600×R²/10000 = 32R + 0.16R². Difference = CI - SI = 0.16R² = 16 ⇒ R² = 100 ⇒ R = 10%.

questions.text: The Tehri Dam, the highest dam in India and one of the tallest in the world, is constructed on which river?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Association Elimination): Match famous dams to rivers instantly. Bhakra Nangal → Sutlej (Option A). Hirakud → Mahanadi (Option C). Sardar Sarovar → Narmada (Option D). By eliminating the three major dams linked to the other three rivers, the only remaining option for Tehri Dam (Uttarakhand) is Bhagirathi. Step-by-step: 1. Locate Tehri Dam: Tehri Garhwal district, Uttarakhand. 2. Identify the river flowing there: Bhagirathi (headstream of Ganga). 3. Confirm height: 260.5 m (highest in India). 4. Cross-check distractors: Bhakra Dam (Sutlej, Himachal), Hirakud Dam (Mahanadi, Odisha), Sardar Sarovar (Narmada, Gujarat). 5. Conclude Option B is correct.

questions.text: What is the largest planet in our solar system in terms of mass?
questions.solution: Jupiter is the largest planet in our solar system in terms of mass, with a mass approximately 318 times that of Earth.

questions.text: The 'Agni' series of missiles developed by DRDO under the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme (IGMDP) are categorized as:
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use DRDO Missile Name-Class association. 'Akash' = Surface-to-Air. 'Nag' = Anti-Tank. 'Astra' = Air-to-Air. 'Prithvi' & 'Agni' = Surface-to-Surface Ballistic. Option C matches the Agni class. Worked Solution: The IGMDP developed five missile systems. Prithvi (Short-range) and Agni (Intermediate/Intercontinental-range) are Surface-to-Surface Ballistic Missiles. Akash is a Medium-range Surface-to-Air Missile. Nag is a Third-generation Anti-Tank Guided Missile. Trishul (short-range SAM) and Astra (Beyond Visual Range Air-to-Air) were later additions. Agni missiles are strategic nuclear-capable ballistic missiles launched from land (surface) to hit land targets (surface).

questions.text: Pointing to a woman in a photograph, a man says, 'She is the only daughter of the father of my mother's brother.' How is the woman related to the man?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Back-tracking Method): Start from the man. Mother's brother = Maternal Uncle (+1 generation). Father of Uncle = Maternal Grandfather (+2 generations). Only daughter of Grandfather = Mother (since the man's mother is the only daughter). Step-by-step: 1. Man's Mother's Brother = Maternal Uncle. 2. Father of Maternal Uncle = Maternal Grandfather. 3. Only daughter of Maternal Grandfather = Man's Mother (as she has no sisters). Hence, the woman is the man's Mother.

questions.text: In a mixture of 60 litres, the ratio of milk to water is 2:1. How much water must be added to make the ratio 1:2?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Milk remains constant at 40 L. For final ratio 1:2, water should be 2×40 = 80 L. Additional water = 80−20 = 60 L. Full: Initial milk = (2/3)×60 = 40 L, water = 20 L. Let x be added water. Then 40/(20+x) = 1/2 → 80 = 20+x → x = 60 L.

questions.text: Three resistors of 2 Ω, 3 Ω, and 6 Ω are connected in parallel across a battery. What is the equivalent resistance of the combination?
questions.solution: Shortcut: For parallel resistors, calculate the sum of reciprocals: 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = (3+2+1)/6 = 1. The equivalent resistance is the reciprocal of this sum, i.e., 1/1 = 1 Ω. Full Method: Using the formula 1/Req = 1/R1 + 1/R2 + 1/R3. Substituting values: 1/Req = 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/6 = 1. Therefore, Req = 1 Ω.

questions.text: A product marked at ₹800 is sold after two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. What is the selling price?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Effective discount = 20+10−(20×10/100)=28%; Selling price = 800×(100−28)/100 = 800×0.72 = ₹576. Full: After 20% discount price = 800×0.8 = ₹640; after further 10% discount = 640×0.9 = ₹576.

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'ROAD' is written as 'URDG'. How will 'SIGN' be written in that code language?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Compare the position values of the first letters (R=18, U=21) to detect a constant forward shift of +3. Apply +3 to each letter of 'SIGN'. Worked Solution: R+3=U, O+3=R, A+3=D, D+3=G confirms the pattern. For SIGN: S(19)+3=V(22), I(9)+3=L(12), G(7)+3=J(10), N(14)+3=Q(17). The coded word is VLJQ.

questions.text: Deficiency of which vitamin causes Rickets in children?
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'D' for 'D' (Rickets/D). Sunlight helps synthesize Vitamin D; lack of it softens bones (Rickets in kids, Osteomalacia in adults). Full Solution: Vitamin D (Calciferol) is essential for calcium and phosphorus absorption in the body. Its deficiency leads to defective mineralization of bones. In children, this manifests as Rickets (bow legs, pigeon chest, delayed dentition). Vitamin A deficiency causes Night Blindness/Xerophthalmia. Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) deficiency causes Beri-Beri. Vitamin C (Ascorbic Acid) deficiency causes Scurvy.

questions.text: A sum of ₹5000 amounts to ₹6200 in 4 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest per annum?
questions.solution: Shortcut: SI = Amount − Principal = 1200; Rate = (SI×100)/(P×T) = (1200×100)/(5000×4) = 6%. Full: Simple Interest = 6200−5000 = 1200; using formula SI = (P×R×T)/100 → 1200 = (5000×R×4)/100 → R = 6%.
